note: Per-platform minimums for dubizzle Egypt. Configuration, not skill logic. Values come from RULES.md and design-kit/layout/layout.json: 768px is the real desktop/mobile split, targets are >=24px (WCAG 2.2 AA) and aim for 44px on mobile. A project can override any key in design-kit/qa/platforms.json.

web-mobile.label: Web mobile (<768px)
web-mobile.notes: 24px is the blocking floor; below 44px is reported as a note. Bottom nav and sheets respect the safe-area inset.
